column3: With respect to the Courtyard Amarillo Downtown Mortgage Loan (2.1%), pursuant to an agreement (the “TIRZ Agreement”) between the developer of the Mortgaged Property, the City of Amarillo Texas (the “City”), and Tax Increment Reinvestment Zone No. 1 City of Amarillo Texas (the “Zone”), the benefits of which were assigned to the borrower, the related Mortgaged Property benefits from a 20-year annual 90% reimbursement of tax increment (the difference in tax revenue on the Mortgaged Property between the year in which the TIRZ Agreement was approved and January 1 of each subsequent year during its term) until the earlier of (i) expiration of the TIRZ Agreement or (ii) a cap of $1,657,716 has been reached. The TIRZ Agreement commenced in November 2011, and will expire in November 2031. Approximately $808,671 of the cap has been used through 2024, resulting in an average annual reimbursement from 2011 through 2024 of approximately $57,762. Approximately $849,045 of the cap remains available, subject to tax rates, appraisals and availability of funds.
